experimental_design.evidence: inferred: Cryopreserved normal CD34 + bone marrow cells were derived from eight healthy Caucasians (four men and four women; PromoCell GMBH; Heidelberg, Germany), and their age did not differ significantly from the AML patients analysed in the study.

number_of_biological_replicates.evidence: We reanalyzed a previous liquid chromatography with tandem mass spectrometry (LC–MS/MS)-characterized proteomic cohort including AML cells from 50 Caucasian patients with non-APL variants of AML at the time of first diagnosis (Table 1).

number_of_samples.evidence: The submitted samples have been analyzed together with raw files derived from 50 different AML patient samples (9 patients samples in this project and 41 patient samples in project PXD014997).
